payload.claim: Rewriting `Agent`'s docstring to satisfy step 6 (and the prose gate's length/sentence constraints) dropped the parenthetical that was in the base text explaining why `event` is "never re-typed": "(no Agent SDK type is imported here or anywhere outside `agent_runner.py`)". The new sentence at line 295 keeps the words "never re-typed" but no longer says why, and that cross-reference to the gated invariant ("images/agent_runner.py — the only file permitted to import the Agent SDK", CLAUDE.md) is not present anywhere else in events.py (confirmed by grep for "Agent SDK" in the file, which only matches an unrelated sentence at line 776). The spec's step 6 named only two specific claims to correct (the `event`/`original_chars` sentence and the two `usage`/"kept verbatim" texts); it did not ask for the rest of the docstring to be rewritten, and this content loss is a side effect of that broader rewrite rather than anything the acceptance criteria require.
